title: Unraveling the iterative CHAD
abstract: arXiv:2505.15002v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Combinatory Homomorphic Automatic Differentiation (CHAD) was originally formulated as a semantics-driven source-to-source transformation for reverse-mode automatic differentiation of total functional programs. We extend CHAD to programs with partial operations, data-dependent conditionals, and while-loops, preserving its defining principle of structure-preserving semantics.   Our main contribution is the introduction of iteration-extensive indexed categories, which integrate iteration into dependently typed programming languages. Iteration in the base category lifts to parameterized initial algebras in the indexed category, yielding fibred iteration on the op-Grothendieck construction. Its total category is the category of containers associated with the dependently typed target language. translated_title: 揭开迭代式CHAD的神秘面纱
translated_abstract: 组合同态自动微分（CHAD）最初被表述为一种语义驱动的源到源转换技术，用于全函数程序的反向模式自动微分。我们将CHAD扩展至包含部分操作、数据依赖条件语句和while循环的程序，同时保持其结构保持语义这一定义性原则。我们的主要贡献是引入了迭代扩张的索引范畴，该范畴将迭代整合到依赖类型编程语言中。基础范畴中的迭代可提升为索引范畴中的参数化初始代数，从而在op-Grothendieck构造上产生纤维化迭代。其总范畴即为与依赖类型目标语言相关联的容器范畴。
tldr: 本文将CHAD自动微分技术从全函数程序扩展至支持部分操作、数据依赖条件和while循环的程序，并提出迭代扩张索引范畴这一新框架，将迭代机制整合进依赖类型编程语言。
en_tdlr: This paper extends CHAD to programs with partial operations, data-dependent conditionals, and while-loops, introducing iteration-extensive indexed categories that integrate iteration into dependently typed programming languages while preserving structure-preserving semantics.
